catches: Referrer earns a $100 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral; cap of $500 (5 referrals) per calendar year.

Friend must register via the referral link/email, open a new personal checking account, and within 60 days: enroll in eStatements AND complete direct deposits totaling $500+ OR 12+ debit card transactions (non-ATM).
Reward for new members only; referrer must register for the program and share the offer.
Cards delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements complete; gift cards expire 90 days from issue.
TruChoice employees are ineligible; offer can change at any time without notice.
Visa Reward Cards may be reported as income to the IRS.
